_comment: Copy to sources.json (gitignored). One entry per stream: its page at /<slug> and its listener on taurus. listed=false keeps a source off the landing page (reachable by URL, noindex). listener.input is a URL or a file on the server; local_input overrides it for scripts/dev.sh. Ports must be unique.

sources.name: VLF Natural Radio
sources.subtitle: Live listening
meta: Very low frequency radio, up to 16 kHz
sources.summary: Earth's own radio. A receiver near Heidelberg turns very low frequency radio waves into sound: the crackle of lightning strikes thousands of kilometres away (sferics), falling tones that travel along the magnetic field (whistlers), and the steady hum of the power grid.
